scripts.deploy:appengine:development: gcloud app deploy app-engine.development.yaml --project <insert project id here>

scripts.deploy:appengine:production: gcloud app deploy app-engine.production.yaml --project <insert project id here>
scripts.predeploy:development: firebase use development && firebase functions:config:set env.value="development" env.node_env="development"
scripts.deploy:development: npm run predeploy:development && firebase deploy --only functions
scripts.predeploy:staging: firebase use staging && firebase functions:config:set env.value="staging" env.node_env="staging"
scripts.deploy:staging: npm run predeploy:staging && firebase deploy --only functions
scripts.predeploy:production: firebase use production && firebase functions:config:set env.value="production" env.node_env="production"
scripts.deploy:production: npm run predeploy:production && firebase deploy --only functions
